basic_details.short_information: Hinduhridaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Medical College & Dr. R.N. Cooper Municipal General Hospital, Juhu, Mumbai, under the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC), is filling 2 posts on contract basis for up to 3 years: 1 Assistant Professor with a fixed pay of Rs. 1,10,000/- and 1 Senior Resident with a fixed pay of Rs. 1,00,000/-. Applications are offline in the prescribed format and must reach the Administrative Office of the college in Juhu, Mumbai on or before 3 November 2026, up to 12.00 pm. The interview will be held on 4 November 2026 at 12:00 PM.

how_to_apply: Applications are offline, in the prescribed format. The notice gives these steps:
Fill in the prescribed application form completely in your own handwriting. Incomplete forms will not be considered.
Write your full correspondence address with PIN code, along with your telephone number, mobile number and e-mail ID.
Affix a recent passport size photograph to the form and sign it at the place provided.
Attach self-attested xerox copies of the documents listed below.
Pay the application form fee of Rs.870 + GST (18%) = Rs.1028/-. The notice does not say how the fee is paid.

Make sure the application reaches Ground floor, Administrative Office, New Hinduhridaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Medical College building, Vileparle (West), Juhu, Mumbai - 400056 on or before 3 November 2026, up to 12.00 pm.
Applications received after this date and time will not be considered, and no correspondence about them will be accepted.

The interview venue is Ground floor, Dean Office, Board Room, New Hinduhridaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Medical College building, Vileparle (W) Juhu, Mumbai-400056. Candidates must attend the interview at their own expense.
important_instructions: Candidature can be cancelled at any time and at any stage if the candidate does not meet the required qualifications and conditions. Candidature can also be cancelled during selection or after selection if the candidate gave false information, certificates or papers, or hid required information. The Hon. Municipal Commissioner has the right to cancel the selection list at any time without giving notice. The Municipal Commissioner, Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, has the right to stop the selection process at any time and at any stage.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice lists these educational requirements: Qualifications as laid down by the National Medical Commission in the Minimum Qualifications for Teachers in Medical Institutions Regulations, 1998, as amended up to 14 February 2022. The candidate must be registered with the Maharashtra Medical Council. The candidate must have an M.D degree or DNB or M.S degree from a recognized University. Self-attested xerox copies of all the required educational qualifications (marksheets and certificates) must be attached to the filled application form. For both posts, the candidate should be not more than 38 years and not less than 18 years old. The notice does not give the date on which age will be counted. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on contract basis, for up to 3 years, and is not a regular appointment. It will not be treated as a regular appointment. A candidate appointed on contract will be discontinued at any time if not required. A candidate can be terminated without prior notice at any stage if a qualified candidate is selected by the M.M.S.S. Board. Selected candidates will not be entitled to any holidays/vacation or any kind of leave available under the Service Rules for the permanent and regular employees of MCGM. Selected candidates must mark biometric attendance both when entering and when leaving the premises. Attendance is not considered valid if they fail to do so. Selected candidates must join within 7 working days. Selected candidates will be posted at Hinduhridaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Medical College & Dr. R.N. Cooper Municipal General Hospital. For the post of Assistant Professor, the notice refers to terms and conditions under sanction no. Director/M.E. & M.H./490 dated 28 May 2024, which it says are attached. These terms are not printed in the pages of the notice.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Attested xerox copies of: Leaving Certificate Birth Certificate Domicile Certificate Educational Qualification Certificates (marksheets and certificates, self-attested) Secondary and Higher Secondary School Examination Mark List Employment Qualification Certificate Marriage Certificate and Gazette copy of name change, for married female candidates. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BMC Cooper Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 vacancies: 1 Assistant Professor and 1 Senior Resident, both on contract basis for up to 3 years.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Cooper Hospital Assistant Professor and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Administrative Office of the college in Juhu, Mumbai on or before 3 November 2026, up to 12.00 pm. Late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Cooper Hospital posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.D degree or DNB or M.S degree from a recognized University, registration with the Maharashtra Medical Council, and the qualifications laid down by the National Medical Commission for teachers in medical institutions. The Assistant Professor post also needs one year of Senior Resident teaching experience in the subject in a recognized medical college.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BMC Cooper Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates for both posts should be not more than 38 years and not less than 18 years old.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Assistant Professor and Senior Resident at Cooper Hospital?
faq.answer: The fixed pay is Rs. 1,10,000/- for the Assistant Professor and Rs. 1,00,000/- for the Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application form fee?
faq.answer: The application form fee is Rs.870 + GST (18%) = Rs.1028/-.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for BMC Cooper Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application form in your own handwriting, affix a signed photograph and attach self-attested copies of your documents. The application must reach Ground floor, Administrative Office, New Hinduhridaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Medical College building, Vileparle (West), Juhu, Mumbai - 400056 by 3 November 2026, 12.00 pm.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the Cooper Hospital interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 4 November 2026 at 12:00 PM at Ground floor, Dean Office, Board Room, New Hinduhridaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Medical College building, Vileparle (W) Juhu, Mumbai-400056. Candidates attend at their own expense.

faq.question: Q9. Is the BMC Cooper Hospital job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract basis for up to 3 years, will not be treated as regular, and can be discontinued at any time if not required.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate who is in service must submit a No Objection Certificate from the previous employer.
